blocks.title: Project Genie — Experimenting with infinite interactive worlds

richText.text: I'm leading design for Project Genie
, exploring how Google DeepMind’s
latest frontier world model
can enable new consumer experiences. I partner across product and research to shape product strategy and inform evolving model capabilities.
Explore the public Project Genie experience ↗
Role
Lead UX design across a team of designers
, setting the experience vision, design direction, and product principles.
Shape product direction and strategy with product managers and research scientists
, translating emerging model capabilities into potential consumer use cases and bringing product and UX learnings into model development.
The challenge
The latest model is still taking shape.

Product vision and model development need to inform each other. I lead the effort to explore what the latest model can enable through prototypes, bringing concrete product possibilities into the conversation with product managers and model research team.
Prototype with the model.
I led cross-functional prototyping sprints
to define a product vision and explore the latest model through prototypes. Working with the technology at an early stage helps us identify possible experiences and use cases.
Define the vision.
Lead the cross-functional team in articulating a product vision around emerging model capabilities.
Make the vision tangible.
Lead the prototyping effort, creating experiences with the early model to explore potential use cases.
Inform the next iteration.
Bring prototype learnings and model feedback to inform model hill-climbing and product opportunities.
Shape product direction
I work with the product managers to shape product direction, strategy, and roadmap.

Our partnership connects emerging world-model capabilities with potential consumer use cases and the experiences we want to build. I set the UX vision and design direction, establishing interaction patterns and principles for a new category of AI experience.
Feed product learnings back into the model
I share model feedback with Research team
from a product and UX perspective. Our prototypes and learnings inform the direction of model improvement and help identify potential use cases.
Emerging model capabilities → prototypes → product learnings → model direction
Lead the design team
I lead a team of designers
across disciplines. Across parallel workstreams, I create coherence through shared interaction patterns, product principles, and a clear experience strategy.
